Output format:
- Return valid JSON only (no markdown fences, no extra text).
- Follow the provided Pydantic schema exactly.
- Field guidance from schema descriptions:
- `flows`: One string per data flow. Format: 'source | sink | sanitized(true/false) | file1, file2, ...'. Example: 'request.body | sql.execute | false | src/db.py, src/routes.py'
- `sanitization_points`: One string per sanitization point. Format: 'file_path:line | function_name | type | protects_against'. Example: 'src/utils.py:42 | sanitize_html | html_encoding | CWE-79'
- `sinks`: One string per security-critical sink. Format: 'sink_type | file_path:line | function_name | notes'. Example: 'sql_execute | src/db.py:55 | run_query | Direct string concatenation'
